**r7: R276 (E1 damping, H.23(k)).** The EIB carries **R276 10.0 ohm 1 % 0603 (CRCW060310R0FKEA, the R273 part number)** in series with E1 at the EIB E1 pad, between the E1 lead and the EIB REGN node (C205). Without R276, E1 with its E8 return and C205 (100 nF) is a series LC at 1.471 MHz (85 mm) or 1.430 MHz (90 mm), against the 1.5 MHz BQ25798 switching frequency (JP24/EM19). On the DC wire resistance the undamped Q is 19.3 (85 mm) and 19.1 (90 mm), or 25.5 and 25.6 with the E8 return at its 20 mm maximum. With the skin-effect resistance (Rac/Rdc 1.71 at 1.43 MHz) these fall to 13.1 and 13.0 (18.4 and 18.5); all are upper bounds, since the proximity effect and the C205 ESR frequency dependence are not modelled. With R276 the Q is 0.108 (85 mm) and 0.111 (90 mm): the loop is overdamped (zeta 4.6 and 4.5). R276 with C205 is also a 159 kHz low-pass, so a 1.5 MHz REGN ripple reaches C205 at 0.106 of its EVM amplitude; T-C-16 checks the ring. The static drop across R276 is 1.02 mV at the H.15 E1 load (0.102 mA, held, R254 only, REGN 4.8 V) and at most 3.96 mV (0.396 mA, released into the regen clamp, REGN 5.2 V). In the held states Q203 is off and Q201 sets the hold level, so the drop changes nothing. In the released states the drop lowers the ILIM_HIZ release level by at most 1.786 mV, which lowers IINDPM by at most 2.23 mA. This is the safe direction (less input current). The gate drives are unaffected at the mV level.

- **r7 (tabs, feet and the EVM plate; the topology is unchanged):** the CR L2 GND plane continues without a break into tab X and tab Y. Every tab-side pad, part and bottom passive therefore returns to the same plane, which still bonds to MB GND only at CHG pads 4/14/15. The far-end feet FT1 and FT2 are non-conductive (PA66 or PBT blocks on neutral-cure RTV beds) and add no ground contact between the CR and the MB. The MB vias are not tented (H.23(c2)); the polyimide sheet and the L4 solder mask keep the tab undersides off the exposed via rings. The EVM plate is insulating, and no fastener, clamp or adhesive bonds EVM copper to the plate, the CR or the chassis (checked in T-A-02). The single-point scheme above therefore holds as written: the EVM ground reaches the CR only through W2 and W4, and the EIB ground reaches the EVM only through E8 at TP49 and the CR only through R273.
